QUOTE: `data` ... Clearing action `index(action='refresh')`; `code` ... "Restart the MCP client only. A rebuild does not help." Also: "Retrying a refresh cannot clear a `code` or newer-schema problem."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says data is cleared by a refresh (rebuild) and code only by a client restart, and that a rebuild can't clear the code axis. That's the substance of the item, even though it never says outright that one flag wouldn't have been enough.
